_comment: The portal's tool specifications, as its trading and service integrations propose them. The capability policy decides which reach the model, by the client's mandate and the risk screen (R-15).

tools.name: place_trade
tools.description: Queue a market order on the client's account for the client to confirm.

tools.name: schedule_advisor_call
tools.description: Book a call with the client's advisor.

tools.name: open_case
tools.description: Open a service case for a human team.

tools.name: transfer_funds
tools.description: Move money out of the account.
